title: Contractors & Home Services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping)
guidance:
- **Win customers:** Google search and Maps, reviews, emergency calls, quote requests, referrals.
- **Audit signals:** click-to-call on mobile, emergency/24-hour wording, quote form, service-area pages, financing page, reviews recency.
- **Tools to detect:** Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, FieldPulse, Workiz.
- **Likely needs:** 1) fast lead response and after-hours handling 2) quote follow-up 3) service-area landing pages and Google profile 4) reviews 5) ads.
- **AI / automation:** inbound after-hours call answering, missed-call text-back, quote follow-up sequence, review request after job, maintenance-plan reminders.
- **Opening questions:** "When a call comes in after hours, does it reach someone or voicemail?" · "After a quote goes out, is there a set follow-up?"
- **Bundle:** Local Lead Engine. **Season (Calgary):** furnace Oct–Mar, AC May–Aug, roofing spring and summer hail season, landscaping spring, snow removal winter.
- **Cautions:** never claim missed calls or lost jobs. If Jobber/Housecall Pro is present, quote follow-up may already exist.

title: Healthcare & Clinics (medical, dental, physio, chiro, optometry)
guidance:
- **Win customers:** search, insurance/benefit directories, referrals, reviews.
- **Audit signals:** online booking link and where it goes, new-patient form, hours, multiple practitioners, services pages.
- **Tools to detect:** Jane, Cliniko, Dentrix, ABELDent, ClinicSense, Accuro, Oscar.
- **Likely needs:** 1) easier booking and reminders 2) reception phone load 3) new-patient intake 4) local search and reviews 5) clear service pages.
- **AI / automation:** administrative inbound call help, booking requests, reminders, intake forms, FAQ assistant (hours, services, fees).
- **Opening questions:** "How are appointment calls handled when the front desk is busy?" · "Can new patients complete intake before they arrive?"
- **Bundle:** Smart Front Desk (after feasibility). **Season:** steady; benefits use-it-or-lose-it rush Nov–Dec.
- **Cautions:** administrative only, no clinical advice. Some systems (e.g. Jane) do not accept direct calendar writes; offer booking requests + handoff instead. Privacy sensitive: no patient data in demos.
